_doc: The pipe scheme (spec 2026-11-11), shared by frontend lib/pipeScheme.ts and backend app/services/pipe_scheme.py so both give one scheme for a room. `geometry`, `riser` and `points` are the studio's (mm; an element's position is its left edge from the wall's own start); `input` is the normalised room the rule sees and `expected` the scheme. The backend test converts the geometry to metres and element positions to middle fractions. Regenerate only with the studio code it checks, and read each result against the rule.

cases.name: one door on D, two cold points (the hand-worked case)
no door: the largest gap is the cut
two doors: the largest door gap is the cut, the other is crossed
a window does not cut the loop
Hammom: bathtub on A, toilet on B, sink on C, shower in a corner, a towel rail, a door on D
a point at the riser, alone
a point on a wall the room lacks, one past its wall, one below the floor
